faqs.a:
In districts for the acquisition or improvement of sidewalks alone or in combination
               with other improvements, the work may include the necessary grading from curbline
               to lot line; and, if the sidewalk project is not combined with any other project,
               the owner of any lot or tract to be assessed shall have the right to construct or
               to reconstruct his own walks in conformity with the plans and specifications for the
               district within 30 days from the publication of the ordinance authorizing the improvement.
(Code 1981, § 27-122; Ord. No. 551, § 63, 5-14-1964)
